description: This file contains several shell functions related to git operations, such as creating commits, generating abbreviated object IDs, formatting output for human readability, filtering output, and comparing references. It appears to facilitate automation and testing of git workflows within a larger project.

methods.name: create_commits_in
methods.description: Creates commits in a specified repository and assigns each commit's oid to variables passed as arguments.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated object ID from a given full oid.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command output into a user-friendly and stable text by replacing commit IDs and locale error messages.

methods.name: filter_out_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Filters the output from 'make_user_friendly_and_stable_output' based on provided arguments.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Formats input lines and saves them to a file called 'expect'.

methods.name: test_cmp_refs
methods.description: Compares git references, utilizing formatted output for comparison.
